description_en: Retrieves the list of image secrets for an edge container application
description_zh: 获取边缘容器应用的镜像秘钥列表
name: ListEdgeContainerAppImageSecrets

parameters.description_en:
The application ID. You can call the [ListEdgeContainerApps](~~ListEdgeContainerApps~~) operation to obtain the application ID.
><notice>The AppId format is the prefix app- followed by a numeric suffix, with a total length of 20 to 64 characters (example: app-8806886***83794688). Call ListEdgeContainerApps to obtain an existing AppId, or call CreateEdgeContainerApp to create an application first.</notice>.
parameters.description_zh:
应用ID，可使用[ListEdgeContainerApps](~~ListEdgeContainerApps~~)接口获取应用ID。
><notice>AppId 格式为 app- 前缀后接纯数字后缀，总长度20至64字符（示例：app-8806886***83794688）。可调用 ListEdgeContainerApps 获取已有 AppId，或先调用 CreateEdgeContainerApp 创建应用。</notice>
